# P1.1 A5 — Caption / alt-text sample (15 frames)

**Policy:** captions are NOT auto-generated by default. When a frame is installed, its caption is derived from the already-available judge explanation (pixel-grounded "why this image helps this passage") plus the section heading, without a fresh vision call. Alt text is a concise visible description (no timestamps, no "Source frame"). Author edits are preserved for same frame ids.

**Sample:** 15 published frames (software UI, terminal, hardware, connectors, before/after, text-poor). Generated captions are one sentence + provenance; alt is visible-only.

| # | Article / Section | Frame | Generated caption | Alt | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | TrueNAS / Opening | f-92139b (Pi NAS hardware) | "Top-down view of the Pi NAS enclosure with SSDs and labels — illustrates TrueNAS comes to Arm" | "Pi NAS enclosure with SSDs and labels" | grounded — no invented text |
| 2 | TrueNAS / UEFI problem | f-6bffaa5 (forum thread) | "Forum thread titled UEFI on Pi — illustrates the community debate about Pi UEFI support" | "Forum thread titled UEFI on Pi" | grounded |
| 3 | TrueNAS / Adding UEFI | f-6856cce (terminal) | "Terminal showing rpi-eeprom-update beta switch command — illustrates adding UEFI to Raspberry Pi" | "Terminal showing rpi-eeprom-update command" | grounded, no command invented |
| 4 | TrueNAS / Install | f-54fec68 (dialog) | "TrueNAS installation succeeded dialog — illustrates successful install" | "Installation succeeded dialog" | grounded |
| 5 | TrueNAS / HomePiNAS | f-d2cafc93 (HDD) | "Hands installing SATA drive into 3D-printed bay — illustrates drive-not-recognized failure" | "Hands installing SATA drive" | grounded |
| 6 | TrueNAS / ZFS | f-b8da329 (terminal) | "Terminal with zpool create RAIDZ1 — illustrates ZFS on Pi NAS" | "Terminal with zpool create command" | grounded |
| 7 | Steam Deck / Opening | f-48fdfeb (teardown) | "Back panel removed showing battery shield and screws — illustrates opening the Steam Deck" | "Back panel removed showing battery shield" | grounded |
| 8 | Steam Deck / Controls | f-940a6c (M.2+thumbstick) | "M.2 SSD shielding and thumbstick area — illustrates replaceable controls and storage" | "M.2 SSD and thumbstick area" | grounded |
| 9 | Steam Deck / Mainboard | f-d154431 (full board) | "Full internal layout with mainboard and thermal system — illustrates inside the mainboard" | "Full internal layout with mainboard" | grounded |
| 10 | Steam Deck / Battery | f-b089195 (X-ray) | "X-ray view of internal components — illustrates battery and repair considerations" | "X-ray view of internal components" | acceptable — X-ray is not sales overlay |
| 11 | Notion / Task DB | f-a51e6 (Relation dialog) | "Relation property dialog showing task linkage — illustrates sub-tasks relation" | "Relation property dialog" | grounded |
| 12 | Notion / Dashboard | f-0c0a3cf (dashboard) | "Dashboard with project overview — illustrates goals and future planning" | "Dashboard with project overview" | grounded |
| 13 | Terminal / ZFS | f-eef60f (transfer UI) | "File transfer progress with 250 MB/s — illustrates ZFS performance" | "File transfer progress bar" | grounded — speed matches narration |
| 14 | Hardware / Connectors | f-ba77bac (Pi connectors) | "Raspberry Pi with Ethernet dongle and hat — illustrates network via USB dongle" | "Raspberry Pi with Ethernet dongle" | grounded |
| 15 | Text-poor / Battery | f-92139b | "Pi NAS hardware overview — illustrates Petabyte Pi project" | "Pi NAS hardware overview" | grounded |

**Hallucination check:** No captions assert exact text, commands, components, numbers or warnings not in pixels or narration. The 250 MB/s case is corroborated by transcript (382.7 s). No "Source frame" generic remains. Provenance (m:ss link) is separate from caption.

**Decision:** Sample shows reliably grounded descriptions with no materially incorrect technical claims, but two text-poor photographs required human judgment on visible detail. Automatic captions remain **optional** by default; they become default-on only after a larger blind review. Alt-text fallbacks are now populated for all installed images.
